text: Kitty played the opening bars, and looked round at Varenka. “Let’s skip that,” said Varenka, flushing a little. Kitty let her eyes rest on Varenka’s face, with a look of dismay and inquiry. “Very well, the next one,” she said hurriedly, turning over the pages, and at once feeling that there was something connected with the song. “No,” answered Varenka with a smile, laying her hand on the music, “no, let’s have that one.” And she sang it just as quietly, as coolly, and as well as the others.
